title: Bounded Google Drive folder authorization and scope boundary review
reason: Scope boundary strictly enforced under narrow drive.file (https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file); synthetic and live tests prove that selecting a folder authorizes the folder container itself, but DOES NOT grant OAuth permissions to unpicked pre-existing or external descendant files; automatic recursive folder mirroring cannot function under drive.file; comprehensive broader-scope proposal authored in docs/engineering/google-drive-restricted-scope-mirroring-proposal.md detailing restricted scopes (drive.readonly / drive), mandatory ADA CASA AL2 security assessment, annual recertification, and $675 to $5,400+ annual lab costs; bounded folder tree hierarchy (buildAuthorizedDriveTree) delivered in domain, Web, and Mobile UI with familiar folder nesting, truthful unpicked descendant notices, and copy vs reference indicators; traversal boundaries enforced without root or sibling folder enumeration; disconnect guarantees verified (stored tokens wiped, jobs cancelled, remote originals never deleted); vault content strictly excluded; workspace scoping strictly enforced; 17 tests in tests/integration/phase107-drive-folder-boundary.test.ts pass; status recorded as blocked pending owner Google Cloud OAuth credentials (DEF-V2-005) and CASA restricted scope authorization.

ownerGoogleCloudCredentials.detail: Owner Google Cloud project OAuth client credentials (DAYNORI_DRIVE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID/SECRET) unconfigured in environment.

liveGoogleConsent.detail: Interactive user consent through accounts.google.com unexecuted; fake provider strictly rejected in production runtimes.

driveFileScopeValidation.detail: Narrow drive.file scope approved; lookalike, broad (drive, drive.readonly), and unauthorized URIs rejected.

folderDescendantBoundary.detail: Proved that drive.file grants access only to folder container and app-created/picked children, not unpicked external descendants.

traversalBoundary.detail: Root Drive and sibling folder enumeration strictly rejected.

hierarchicalFolderTree.detail: buildAuthorizedDriveTree constructs nested folder hierarchy without enumerating the rest of Drive.

disconnectSafety.detail: Tokens wiped, generation incremented, jobs fenced, imported copies kept locally, remote Drive originals untouched (remoteOriginalDeleted: false).

vaultExclusion.detail: isVaultDriveTarget strictly excludes vault items and keys with HTTP 403 vault_excluded.

workspaceIsolation.detail: Cross-workspace operations and token leaks fail closed.

casaRestrictedScopeProposal.detail: Detailed proposal authored with ADA CASA AL2 requirements, annual recertification, and cost models.
